reference.Scope: Synthetic stereo instrument comparison only. No encoded outputs, broadcasting PC, normalization, limiter, UI or full EBU test-set acceptance.

audio.Scope: Real isolated AAC-LC/24-bit Ogg FLAC, synthetic live mix and recovery only. Includes five-signal fixed source gain and two low-crest normalized AAC-LC/FLAC branches. No HE-AAC/18-output/final limiter/worst-case codec headroom/actual-PC/24-72h or mouse acceptance.

Cases.Source: New independent implementation; no production configuration or services accessed.

Checks.Description: The program continues across a full song/ad/sweeper cycle.
Both encoders and source sessions remain persistent across content boundaries.
Healthy outputs lose no PCM blocks.
Audit work does not overflow or fail.

Real audio loop publishes continuous measured final-mix coverage without blocking outputs.
Measured final-mix window closes durably with real sample boundaries.
